suite: Playwright (Chromium) against the published ASP.NET Core build, run locally on Kestrel
covered: every page at 1366px and 390px wide: no script errors, no broken images, no sideways scrolling
navigation, mobile menu (open, Escape, outside click), 404 page
quick add, piece details, preferences, quantity limits, thumbnails, deep links
saved picks: drawer, quantity, remove, clear, persistence, sync between tabs
WhatsApp draft links and copy to clipboard (secure and plain-http fallback)
collection filters, search, sort and shareable URLs
gallery lightbox: buttons, arrow keys, wrap-around, backdrop close
contact enquiry draft and validation; no personal data in URLs
old .html links redirect; security headers; noindex; compression; caching
Let's Encrypt validation files served; config and binaries not downloadable
limitations: IIS, public DNS and certificate issuance must be checked on the Windows VPS.
